scope: Theorem 9.2 (Conditional-label entropy bound) of the manuscript “Complex Matrix Multiplication Below 2.258 and Rectangular Bounds” (preprints/Complex-Matrix-Multiplication-Below-2.258-and-Rectangular-Bounds-September-24-2026/Complex-Matrix-Multiplication-Below-2.258-and-Rectangular-Bounds-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 107 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 97ffc7fc55cae485), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 62. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If a tensor of cost eC has a readable label tree, then W(rXY(π), rXZ(π), rYZ(π)) ≤ C (9.1) for every leaf law π.
